curation_note: Designed hexa-substituted product of tris(2-aminoethyl)amine with (S)-glycidyl decanoate; 1H NMR of the MPLC-purified material integrates to 6 tails (18H CH3, 12H Hbeta, 12H Halpha). HPLC-ELSD reports the 4-tailed species as 55.26% of total area, so the isolated material is a mixture and this structure is its designed, NMR-supported major-by-NMR component, not a single pure compound.

Partially substituted co-eluting species detected by LC-MS ([M+H]+ computed 1059.85). Which of the three primary nitrogens carries how many arms is NOT determined by any evidence on disk -- the constitution is a positional isomer mixture. NOT emitted.
